meta.sources_summary: Flights: live Google Flights. Hotels: live Booking.com. Ratings/coordinates: Google Maps. Photos: Wikimedia Commons & Google Maps listings. Routes: OSRM (OpenStreetMap). Prices for car, baggage, fuel and some tickets are estimates.

trip.title: Czech Family Road Trip
trip.luggage: 2 checked suitcases (23 kg) + 2 cabin trolleys (8 kg)

flights.note: Live Google Flights results scraped on 15 Oct 2026 for 2 adults + 2 children, economy, one-way searches per leg. Prices are the total for all 4 travellers in EUR, cheapest fare family (Smartwings LITE) and do not include checked bags.

baggage.included: 1 cabin bag up to 8 kg (55×40×23 cm) per passenger, so the 2 cabin trolleys are included (4 are allowed).
baggage.not_included: Checked bags. LITE has no checked allowance; PLUS/FLEX include 1×23 kg.
baggage.fee: From 1,000 CZK (≈ €41) per 23 kg bag per direction when added online in advance (≈ €60 at the airport).
baggage.tip: At booking, compare adding 2 bags to LITE with buying PLUS for 2 of the 4 passengers (PLUS adds the 23 kg bag and a personal item).

alternatives.label: Cheaper evening outbound
alternatives.note: €271 cheaper than the morning flight, but Day 1 becomes travel only. You'd sleep near Prague first, so the order changes to Prague → Lipno → Bohemian Switzerland (see itinerary note).

alternatives.label: Late return (full last day)
alternatives.note: Same price as QS 1284. Gives a full last day (e.g. Aquapalace Praha), but lands at 04:35.

alternatives.label: El Al return
alternatives.note: El Al Lite: on Europe routes the carry-on must be checked at no extra charge, and paid checked bags are on top. Classic includes 23 kg.

alternatives.label: El Al outbound (Thursday)
alternatives.note: Only if you prefer El Al; €486 more than Smartwings evening.

alternatives.label: Israir outbound (Wednesday only)
alternatives.note: Friendlier time than 05:35 and €123 cheaper, but only found on Wed 11 Aug (no matching Israir return). Trolley ≈ $25 and 23 kg bag ≈ $50 per direction are extra (2025 figures).

alternatives.label: Via Vienna, 1 stop
alternatives.note: No saving over Smartwings nonstop, and 1h20 longer.

flights.date_note: Smartwings fares were identical on every date checked (outbound 11–17 Aug: €701 evening / €972 morning; return 19–26 Aug: €919), so hotel prices decide the dates. Saturday has no Israeli-carrier flights (Shabbat).

airport_comparison.note: Car and fee figures for non-Prague options are estimates (rental-company terms found by web search). Flight prices are live Google Flights totals for 4 travellers on Sun 15 Aug / Tue 24 Aug 2027.

car.pickup: Prague Václav Havel Airport (PRG) car rental centre, Sun 15 Aug ≈ 09:30
car.dropoff: Same place, Tue 24 Aug ≈ 09:30 (9 rental days, so return before 09:45 to avoid a 10th day)
car.category: Intermediate/Standard estate (station wagon), automatic – e.g. Škoda Octavia Combi or VW Passat Variant (ACRISS IWAR/SWAR)
car.fit: The Octavia Combi boot (≈ 640 L) takes 2 large suitcases + 2 cabin trolleys, with 2 high-back boosters on the rear seats. Alternative: Intermediate SUV (Škoda Karoq/Kodiaq), ≈ €10–20/day more.
lines: 2 child seats / high-back boosters (≈ €10–13/day each, usually capped)
Cross-border fee for the Germany day (Bastei)
Czech e-vignette (normally included with Czech-registered rental cars – confirm at pick-up)
car.cross_border: Czech rental companies normally allow Germany, Austria, Slovakia and Poland. You must declare it at pick-up. Enterprise-group stations in Czechia charge a €35 (+VAT) cross-border fee per 30 days. Some Sixt terms exclude certain premium brands from some countries, so confirm in the booking terms. If you skip the Bastei day, the car never leaves Czechia.
car.seat_tip: Option: bring your own 2 high-back boosters as checked items and save ≈ €150. Most airlines carry child seats free, but confirm Smartwings' rule before you fly.
sources: Hire Car Prague – Octavia Combi automatic from €45–59/day
KAYAK – Prague car hire: August is the most expensive month
Enterprise CZ – cross-border fee €35 / 30 days (DE, AT, SK, PL)

items: Motorway e-vignette required. 2026 price: 10 days 300 CZK, 30 days 480 CZK. Rental cars registered in Czechia normally have one – check at pick-up.

Children under 36 kg AND under 150 cm must use a child restraint, so both kids need one. High-back boosters suit ages 5 and 7. A backless booster is allowed only from 125 cm and 22 kg. Fine: 1,500–2,000 CZK.
Headlights on day and night. Zero alcohol (0.0‰). Speed limits: 50 km/h in towns, 90 outside, 130 on motorways.
Hands-free phone only. A reflective vest must be in the car. Trams have priority in Prague.
Prague: leave the car at the hotel (free parking) and use metro/trams. Blue street zones are for residents only.
Petrol ≈ €1.85/l (≈ 45 CZK, Oct 2026). Most stations are self-service and take cards.
No vignette or toll for cars.
Children under 12 and under 150 cm need a child seat.
Bastei: paid car park near the bridge. A park-and-ride with a shuttle bus is used when the main park is full.
Digital vignette 10 days €12.80. Children under 14 and under 135 cm need a child seat.

hotels.name: Apartmány Jožák
hotels.room: Standard apartment for 4 with kitchen. Free parking. Playground and indoor play room. Breakfast not included (self-catering).
hotels.why: Best-rated value base for Bohemian Switzerland: 15 min to Hřensko and the gorges, 45 min to Bastei.
hotels.price_source: Booking.com live prices via the Booking.com connector on 15 Oct 2026 (2 adults + 2 children aged 5 and 7; total for the stay incl. taxes as returned).

hotels.name: Apartmány Doky Lipno (A9 & D1)
hotels.area: Lipno nad Vltavou, lakefront (Doky Holiday Resort)
hotels.room: 2-bedroom apartment (sleeps up to 7) with kitchenette. Heated outdoor pool with a shallow end, on the beachfront. Free parking.
hotels.why: Pool, lake beach and 2 bedrooms for €175/night. The Treetop Walkway is 4 km away. Few Booking reviews (43), so also see the alternative.
hotels.google_note: Google rating is for the Doky Holiday Resort complex.

alt.note: Family resort: kids' club, indoor play area, water-park access. €476 more for the same 4 nights.

hotels.name: Grand Hotel International Prague
hotels.room: Family Room (1 king + 2 sofa beds). Breakfast included and free on-site parking (per Booking.com property Q&A).
hotels.why: Free parking and breakfast at €131/night. About 25 min to the airport on departure morning; metro A to the Old Town in about 25 min.

tiske_steny.name: Tiské stěny rock labyrinth
tiske_steny.hours_august: Daily in July–August, timed-entry tickets with a daily visitor cap (since 2025). Buy online.
tiske_steny.price_family_text: Family ticket ≈ 250 CZK (≈ €10); under-6 free. Parking ≈ 100 CZK.
tiske_steny.kids_notes: Sandstone 'rock town' maze of short, easy paths and small climbs. A great first walk after the flight.

photos.credit: Original uploader was Zp at cs.wikipedia · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
photos.title: Tiské stěny.jpg

pravcicka.name: Pravčická brána (Pravčice Gate)
pravcicka.price_family_text: Adults 125 CZK, child 6–14 50 CZK, under-6 free, so 300 CZK (≈ €12) for your family. An older official list shows 95/30 CZK. Bring cash.
pravcicka.kids_notes: Europe's largest natural sandstone arch. From Tři prameny car park it's a steady 2.5 km uphill (about 1 h at kids' pace). Falcon's Nest restaurant at the top.

kamenice_gorge.name: Edmund's Gorge boat ride (Kamenice river)
kamenice_gorge.hours_august: Reopened 18 June 2026 after the 2022 fire. Guided groups daily 10:00–17:00, entry only from Hřensko.
kamenice_gorge.price_family_text: Adult 350 CZK incl. the boat there and back. Child price not yet published (≈ 175 CZK assumed), so ≈ 1,050 CZK (≈ €43) for your family. Tickets on the spot at the Hřensko info centre; limited places.
kamenice_gorge.kids_notes: Flat walk through a mossy canyon, then a quiet boat ride with a boatman. The 2026 groups are small, so arrive early.

wild_gorge.name: Wild Gorge boat ride (Divoká soutěska)
wild_gorge.hours_august: Daily 9:00–17:30 (1 Apr – 1 Nov), last boat 17:30. No reservation.
wild_gorge.price_family_text: Adults 200 CZK, children 3–15 100 CZK, so 600 CZK (≈ €24) for your family.
wild_gorge.kids_notes: Shorter, easier gorge section from Mezní můstek with a boat ride. Good back-up if Edmund's Gorge is sold out.

bastei.name: Bastei Bridge (Saxon Switzerland, Germany)
bastei.price_family_text: Free. Car park ≈ €5–10 (estimate). Felsenburg Neurathen rock castle has been closed since 2023.
bastei.kids_notes: Famous sandstone bridge 194 m above the Elbe, with railed viewpoints and a short, flat path from the car park.

prague_zoo.name: Prague Zoo
prague_zoo.price_family_text: Family ticket (2 adults + up to 4 children 3–15): 850 CZK online / 1,000 CZK at the gate (≈ €35–41).
prague_zoo.kids_notes: One of the world's top-rated zoos: chairlift across the park, children's zoo, Indonesian jungle pavilion, gorillas and elephants.

treetop_lipno.name: Treetop Walkway Lipno

google.name: Treetop Trail Lipno
google.address: Lipno nad Vltavou 307, 382 78 Lipno nad Vltavou, Czechia

treetop_lipno.hours_august: 1 Jun – 28 Sep: 10:00–19:00 (ticket sales end 18:00). Night walk on Thursdays in Jul–Aug.
treetop_lipno.price_family_text: Dynamic pricing: family (2+2) ≈ 730–1,140 CZK. Cheaper if booked online about 14 days ahead. Budget 1,000 CZK (≈ €41). The tube slide is extra.
treetop_lipno.kids_notes: Gentle wooden ramp (stroller-friendly) up to a 40 m tower with lake views; you can come down by the tube slide.

photos.title: Stezka korunami stromů. Lipno nad Vltavou. (17.).jpg

kralovstvi_lesa.name: Kingdom of the Forest (Království lesa)

google.name: Království Lesa Lipno
google.address: Lipno nad Vltavou 307 Lipno nad Vltavou, 382 78 Lipno nad Vltavou, Czechia

kralovstvi_lesa.price_family_text: From 340 CZK per person online; family from ≈ 1,120 CZK (≈ €46). Dynamic prices – buy at lipnocard.cz.
kralovstvi_lesa.kids_notes: Big forest adventure playground next to the Treetop Walkway, with climbing frames, rope bridges and a new marble run (2026).

bobovka_lipno.name: Slideland bobsled track Lipno
bobovka_lipno.hours_august: Daily from about 10:00 to 18:00 (longer on summer weekends)
bobovka_lipno.price_family_text: ≈ 120–150 CZK per ride. Children ride with an adult; budget 4 rides ≈ 600 CZK (≈ €24).
bobovka_lipno.kids_notes: Two summer toboggan runs. Children from 3 ride with a parent.

lipno_beach.name: Lipno lake beach
lipno_beach.kids_notes: Grassy beach with a shallow entry into Lake Lipno, Czechia's largest reservoir. Free to use.

malecek.name: Family rafting on the Vltava (Maleček)

google.name: Malecek Rafting & Canoe - rafting in Cesky Krumlov

malecek.hours_august: May–September daily, trips from 30 min (through the old town) to a full day. Book ahead.
malecek.price_family_text: Not published online for 2026. Estimate ≈ 1,200–1,800 CZK for a family raft on a short section (≈ €50–75). Life jackets and dry bags included.
malecek.kids_notes: Inflatable family raft through Český Krumlov's old town and under the castle. Life jackets are mandatory; there are small weirs with fun 'slides'.

photos.credit: Art Anderson · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
photos.title: Český Krumlov from a river raft - panoramio.jpg

ck_castle.name: Český Krumlov Castle – courtyards, bear moat & gardens
ck_castle.hours_august: Courtyards and moat open daily. Guided tours in August Tue–Sun 9:00–17:00.
ck_castle.price_family_text: Courtyards, bear moat and gardens free. Optional Tour Route I: adult 300, child 6–17 90 CZK.
ck_castle.kids_notes: Brown bears live in the castle moat (a tradition since the 1700s). The painted castle courtyards are free to walk.

photos.credit: Jakub Hałun · CC BY 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
photos.title: Český Krumlov Castle, Czechia, 20250504 1248 8849.jpg

sources: Český Krumlov Castle – Tour Route I (official)

ck_tower.name: Český Krumlov Castle Tower & Museum
ck_tower.price_family_text: Adult 280 CZK, child 6–17 80 CZK, under-6 free, so 640 CZK (≈ €26) for your family (official 2026 prices).
ck_tower.kids_notes: Climb the painted Renaissance tower for the best view over the river bend and the red roofs.

photos.credit: Pudelek (Marcin Szala) · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
photos.title: Český Krumlov (Krummau) - zámecká věž.jpg

klet_lift.name: Kleť chairlift & lookout tower
klet_lift.price_family_text: 2026 fares not published online. Estimate ≈ 640 CZK return for your family + ≈ 100 CZK for the tower (≈ €30).
klet_lift.kids_notes: 20-min chairlift ride up through the forest to the top of the Blanský les hills (1,084 m). On clear days you can see the Alps from the stone tower.

frymburk_ferry.name: Frymburk ferry across Lake Lipno
frymburk_ferry.hours_august: Season from 24 Apr; sails every hour on the hour
frymburk_ferry.price_family_text: 2026 fare not published. A similar Lipno ferry charges 25 CZK per person, so a family return ≈ 200 CZK (≈ €8).
frymburk_ferry.kids_notes: Short car-ferry crossing; kids love the boat. Frymburk has a beach and playground by the pier.

hluboka.name: Hluboká Castle

google.name: The State Chateau of Hluboká
google.address: Hluboká Castle, Zámek 142, 373 41 Hluboká nad Vltavou, Czechia

hluboka.price_family_text: Park free. Castle Kitchen tour (35 min, unguided, family-friendly): 2026 prices not found online. Estimate ≈ 600 CZK (≈ €24) for your family.
hluboka.kids_notes: White fairy-tale castle with an English park. The short kitchen tour suits young kids; buy timed tickets online to skip the queue.

photos.credit: Michal Klajban · CC BY 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
photos.title: Hluboka Castle during sunset.jpg

prague_castle.name: Prague Castle (grounds & changing of the guard)
prague_castle.hours_august: Grounds 6:00–22:00, interiors 9:00–17:00. Changing of the guard every hour; the big ceremony is at 12:00.
prague_castle.price_family_text: Grounds and guard ceremony free. Interiors circuit: family tickets ≈ 560–950 CZK (optional).
prague_castle.kids_notes: Guards' ceremony at noon; St Vitus Cathedral from outside; Golden Lane if you buy the circuit.

photos.credit: Fred Romero from Paris, France · CC BY 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons
photos.title: Praha - Pražský hrad (2).jpg

charles_bridge.name: Charles Bridge
charles_bridge.kids_notes: Statues, street musicians and caricature artists. Touch the St John of Nepomuk plaque for luck.

orloj.name: Old Town Square & Astronomical Clock
orloj.hours_august: The clock's apostles parade every hour 9:00–23:00
orloj.kids_notes: Arrive 5 minutes before the hour: the skeleton rings the bell and the 12 apostles appear.
sources: Prague.eu – Old Town Hall & Astronomical Clock

petrin.name: Petřín Lookout Tower & Mirror Maze
petrin.hours_august: 10:00–18:00, longer on summer dates (verify). The funicular was due to reopen on 22 Sep 2026 after reconstruction (verify).
petrin.price_family_text: Combined tower + maze family ticket 600 CZK (≈ €24). Tower lift +150 CZK per person (optional). Funicular on a public-transport ticket.
petrin.kids_notes: Mini 'Eiffel tower' with a view over Prague, then the funny-mirror maze next door.

slovanka.name: Pedal boats at Slovanka island

google.name: Rental boats and pedal boats Slovanka

slovanka.price_family_text: ≈ 350 CZK per hour (≈ €14). Kids' life jackets free. Cash recommended.
slovanka.kids_notes: Pedal on the Vltava with the castle and National Theatre in view.

photos.credit: Dietmar Rabich · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
photos.title: Prag, Slawische Insel, Tretbootverleih -- 2019 -- 6739.jpg

aquapalace.name: Aquapalace Praha (optional / rainy day)
aquapalace.price_family_text: Family 3-hour ticket 2,849 CZK (≈ €116) on weekdays; the online shop gives weekday prices every day. Under-100 cm free.
aquapalace.kids_notes: Czechia's largest water park: pirate-ship hall, wave pool, lazy river and slides.

days.title: Arrive Prague → Bohemian Switzerland
plan: 05:35 Smartwings QS 1287 from TLV, landing at PRG 08:45. Pick up the car about 09:30.
Drive about 1h40 to Tisá (the kids can nap). Lunch in Tisá.
Afternoon: Tiské stěny rock labyrinth. Book a timed slot online.
Short drive to Apartmány Jožák, check in, playground.

days.title: Pravčická brána + Edmund's Gorge boats
plan: Morning: drive 20 min to Tři prameny car park and walk up 2.5 km (about 1 h) to Pravčická brána. Come back down the same way.
Afternoon: Hřensko. Edmund's Gorge guided walk and boat ride (limited places, so go early). Back-up: Wild Gorge.
Dinner in Hřensko or self-catering at the apartment.

days.title: Bastei Bridge (Germany) + Wild Gorge
plan: Drive 45 min along the Elbe into Saxony and walk out onto the Bastei Bridge and its viewpoints.
Afternoon: Mezní můstek, then the Wild Gorge boat ride (no booking needed). Or a quiet afternoon at the apartment playground.

days.title: Transfer south, with Prague Zoo on the way
plan: Leave about 08:30 and drive 1h40 to Prague Zoo, which is right on the route.
Prague Zoo 10:00–14:30, with lunch inside the zoo.
Drive 2h50 to Lipno (rest stop on the D3 motorway). Evening swim in the apartment pool.

days.title: Lipno: Treetop Walkway, Kingdom of the Forest, bobsled
plan: Morning: Treetop Walkway (book online a couple of weeks ahead for the best price) and the tube slide.
Kingdom of the Forest adventure playground next door, then the bobsled track.
Afternoon: Lipno beach and swim.

legs.from: Treetop Walkway & Kingdom of the Forest

points.name: Treetop Walkway & Kingdom of the Forest

days.title: Český Krumlov: rafting + castle
plan: Drive 35 min. Morning: a family raft on the Vltava through the old town with Maleček (reserve ahead).
Afternoon: castle courtyards and the bear moat (free), then the Castle Tower for the view and ice cream in the old town.
Back to Lipno for an evening swim.

days.title: Kleť viewpoint + Frymburk ferry
plan: Morning: drive 55 min to Krasetín and take the chairlift up Kleť to the stone lookout tower (on clear days you can see the Alps).
Afternoon: Frymburk. Ferry across the lake and back, then the beach and playground by the pier.
Lighter option: skip Kleť and spend the day at Lipno beach and the pool.

days.title: Hluboká Castle → Prague
plan: Drive 1h10 to Hluboká Castle: Castle Kitchen tour (35 min) and the park.
Drive 1h55 to Prague and check in at Grand Hotel International. Free parking; the car stays here until departure.

days.title: Prague city day (metro & tram)
plan: Tram or metro from the hotel to Prague Castle (about 20 min): castle grounds, then the changing of the guard at 12:00.
Walk down through Malá Strana, cross Charles Bridge, and see the Astronomical Clock on the hour.
Afternoon: Petřín funicular, lookout tower and mirror maze. Or pedal boats at Slovanka island.
Back to the hotel by metro A (Dejvická).

days.title: Fly home
plan: Breakfast at the hotel. Leave about 09:00 and drive 30 min to PRG; return the car by 09:30–09:45.
Smartwings QS 1284 departs 12:45 and lands in TLV at 17:35.
If you pick the late QS 1286 (23:45) instead: a full extra day, e.g. Aquapalace Praha (3 h).

variant_note: Evening-flight variant (QS 1285, €271 cheaper): land 21:35 and sleep in Prague. Then run the loop as Prague (2 nights) → Lipno (4) → Bohemian Switzerland (3) → PRG. The departure-morning drive is about 1h50, so leave at 08:30 for QS 1284. Hotel dates would need re-pricing.
